title: Found Unconscious
hpi_narrative: {{patient_name}} presents found unconscious with signs of physical struggle (bruises, abrasions, torn clothing). Management requires a multidisciplinary, trauma-informed approach. Priorities: medical stabilization first (ABCs), then forensic examination. Obtain consent before any exam. Sexual Assault Nurse Examiner (SANE) if available. Forensic evidence collection (rape kit): clothing, swabs, fingernail scrapings, hair samples — ideally within 72h. Document injuries with photographs. Labs: STI testing (chlamydia, gonorrhea, HIV, syphilis, hepatitis), pregnancy test, toxicology screen (drug-facilitated assault —GHB, benzodiazepines, ketamine). Empiric treatment: ceftriaxone + doxycycline + metronidazole for STI prophylaxis. Emergency contraception (levonorgestrel 1.5mg PO once). HIV PEP if within 72h. Report to law enforcement (with consent). Arrange safe discharge and follow-up. Psychiatry/crisis counseling referral.
